services.name: General Dental Consultation
services.short_desc: Comprehensive oral examination, diagnostic review, and personalized care plan.
services.full_desc: Detailed examination of your teeth, gums, tongue, and bite alignment. Includes preventive oral hygiene advice and customized treatment recommendations.

services.name: Dental Cleaning & Polishing
services.short_desc: Gentle ultrasonic scaling to eliminate plaque, stubborn tartar, and surface stains.
services.full_desc: Professional dental scaling prevents gingivitis and periodontal problems. Leaves teeth feeling fresh, clean, and healthy without enamel erosion.

services.name: Teeth Whitening
services.short_desc: Safe, in-office dental whitening to brighten smiles and reduce discoloration.
services.full_desc: High-grade clinical whitening tailored to safely lift coffee, tea, and tobacco stains for a refreshed, naturally radiant smile.

services.name: Tooth Restoration & Fillings
services.short_desc: Tooth-colored composite fillings for decay, chipped edges, and wear.
services.full_desc: Modern composite resin matches the natural shade of your teeth, reinforcing tooth structure and restoring normal chewing function seamlessly.

services.name: Root Canal Treatment
services.short_desc: Gentle, modern procedure to relieve toothache and save the natural tooth.
services.full_desc: Carefully removes infection from inside the tooth pulp, cleans and seals the root canal space, providing lasting pain relief and preserving natural dentition.

services.name: Crowns & Bridges
services.short_desc: Durable custom ceramic and porcelain crowns to restore damaged or missing teeth.
services.full_desc: Custom-crafted dental crowns protect weakened teeth, while bridges provide stable, natural-looking replacement for missing teeth.

services.name: Tooth Extraction
services.short_desc: Painless, gentle tooth removal when preservation is no longer clinically feasible.
services.full_desc: Performed under modern local anesthesia with careful technique to ensure patient comfort and swift healing.

services.name: Children's Dental Care
services.short_desc: Compassionate, kid-friendly dental check-ups, cleanings, and cavity prevention.
services.full_desc: Creating positive early dental experiences for young children. Emphasizes tooth brushing techniques, diet habits, and early prevention.

services.name: Gum Care & Periodontics
services.short_desc: Specialized therapy for bleeding gums, sensitivity, and periodontal health.
services.full_desc: Deep cleaning, root surface debridement, and medicated irrigation to arrest gum bleeding, combat bad breath, and stabilize teeth.

services.name: Cosmetic Dentistry & Smile Design
services.short_desc: Aesthetic recontouring, diastema closure, and composite veneers.
services.full_desc: Comprehensive smile enhancements tailored to your facial aesthetics, addressing gaps, slight crowding, or uneven tooth shapes.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can easily request an appointment online through our website in four simple steps: choose your dental service, pick a convenient date, select an open time slot, and submit your contact details. Our team will promptly confirm your booking.

faqs.question: Can I choose my preferred appointment time?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our dynamic booking system displays real-time available time slots based on doctor availability. Unavailable or already reserved slots are automatically blocked to prevent overlapping bookings.

faqs.question: How can I reschedule or cancel my appointment?
faqs.answer: If you need to change your appointment date or time, please contact the clinic with your booking reference code at least a few hours in advance so we can assist you with alternative slots.

faqs.question: What should I bring to my appointment?
faqs.answer: Please bring any previous dental records, X-rays, or a list of current medications you are taking. Arriving 5 to 10 minutes prior to your scheduled time ensures a smooth check-in.

faqs.question: Do you accept emergency dental appointments?
faqs.answer: Yes, patients with severe dental pain, trauma, or swelling are prioritized based on clinical schedule availability during clinic working hours. Please call ahead if possible so our team can prepare.

faqs.question: What dental services are available at Bhadrannavar Dental Clinic?
faqs.answer: We provide general consultations, teeth cleaning and scaling, fillings, root canals, crowns, tooth extractions, children’s dental care, gum care, and cosmetic smile procedures.

faqs.question: What are your clinic opening hours?
faqs.answer: We operate Monday through Saturday with morning and evening sessions. Exact consultation hours are displayed in our booking calendar and can be customized by the clinic administrator.

faqs.question: Can children visit the clinic?
faqs.answer: Yes, we welcome children of all ages. Our friendly clinical approach is designed to make young patients feel completely safe, calm, and comfortable.
